title: A/R Detail: the PDF prints dates as month, two-digit day and year
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Pick an earlier date, date A, from the 1st to the 9th of a month.
  • Have a customer with an open invoice, invoice A, dated date A and due 30 days later.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with only that customer ticked in the Customer filter.
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to date A.
  2. Expand the "Current" bucket.
  3. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Open the PDF and read its top lines and invoice A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report reloads for date A.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A's Date reads date A as month, day and year (for example "Nov 4, 2026").

Step 3:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 4:

  • Invoice A's Date and Due Date print as three-letter month, two-digit day and year with no comma (for example "Nov 04 2026").
  • The top line reads "As of " and date A; its exact form for a day before the 10th waits on the product owner's answer.

Held: the PDF's top line for a day before the 10th ("As of Nov 4, 2026" or "As of Nov 04, 2026" or "As of Nov 04 2026") is question 18 on Chris Ward's sheet, not sent yet (added 10 Nov 2026); this case stays out of the test run until he answers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R7a: “The PDF uses the app-wide report PDF format, the same as Sales By Customer and Inventory Value: a negative amount prints in brackets with a minus sign, for example "(-$11,111.00)", and dates print as "Nov 04 2026". On screen a negative amount reads "$-11,111.00", as today.”
  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S2-R1a: “Date and Due Date show plain dates on screen, for example "Nov 4, 2026". The PDF and the CSV keep their own date formats (S3-R7a, S3-R8). They never read "Today", "Yesterday" or "2 days ago".”
